notes: E2E/component UI TCs (SessionTimeChart.tsx, MemberFilter.tsx) are deliberately NOT generated. The story's own Test-mapping section names these components, but REQUIREMENTS.md Scope documents both are stale claims: no mockup shows a session-time chart or member filter (dashboards/Program Detail.html has exactly six sections, none of them this chart), and neither component exists under apps/web/src. PGD-06 ships backend-only (design: n/a). This mirrors the PGD-04 precedent for a story claiming a component that does not exist.

Accessibility NFR is explicitly N/A per REQUIREMENTS.md ('no new UI ships in this story') and is intentionally omitted from this manifest; carried forward to the follow-on story that renders the chart against a real design.

Security NFR is covered via FR-6/AC-5 (gate-before-query, PGD-06-TC-08) and a standalone 401 case (PGD-06-TC-12), rather than a separate wholly-distinct set, consistent with PGD-04/05 precedent of anchoring security NFR to the AC/FR gate tests already present.

session_series carries an org_id column, part of uq_session_series_org_id_program_id_member_id_date, that neither the story nor REQUIREMENTS.md mentions. No TC in this manifest pins org_id scoping: REQUIREMENTS.md Solution sketch describes the org-wide query as scanning by (org_id, program_id, date) but the story/PRD never states a cross-org isolation requirement or names an org-scoping FR/AC, and program_visibility/member_in_program_visibility (the only gates this story specifies) are program-scoped, not org-scoped. Treating org_id as in-scope here would fabricate a requirement id absent from both the story and the PRD. Flagging this as a gap for the orchestrator/product owner to confirm before Product Gate: either org_id scoping is implicitly covered by existing multi-tenancy tests elsewhere in the suite (out of this story's stated scope), or it needs an explicit FR/AC added to REQUIREMENTS.md and a corresponding TC in a follow-up round. RESOLVED by the orchestrator 2026-09-17 before the Product Gate: org_id is a hardcoded single-org singleton (`_ORG_ID = "org-1"`, services/api/app/services/rollup_rebuild.py:118, D-03 convention) — every writer stamps that one literal and the system has no multi-tenancy. There is therefore no cross-org isolation requirement to test for this story, and no FR/AC is added. Should real multi-org support ever land, org scoping becomes a system-wide concern for a dedicated story, not a PGD-06 gap.
Scope cross-check: no TC references an Out-of-scope id from REQUIREMENTS.md (chart/filter UI, session_series writes, persona-scoped filtering beyond the two named RBAC gates).
